items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: But then I remember Bill Green, do you know him? ... Yeah. Saxophone player, he just died recently, and Buddy Collette, and a few guys started coming in and they were right. They forced the issue because they were guys that could cut the stuff.

ctx.x: Were the studios integrated at all at that point?
They began to be. When I first started to do it I don’t remember. But then I remember Bill Green, do you know him?
